2608.25091.title: Auto-Policy, not Auto-Skill: Compiled Agent Skills for the Physical World
2608.25091.paper_summary: Self-evolving Skill harnesses (AutoSkills, Hermes Agent) generate more advisory orchestration automatically; their reported gains are efficiency, not safety. This misses the actual gap: a Skill describes how an agent should behave; a Policy decides which behavior is allowed to become an action. Today's format covers the first with markdown and scripts; the second is left to the model. Generating more Skills scales the gap, not the safety, especially when a wrong invocation can unlock a door or move money. Two adjacent attacks are documented: malicious skills compromising cloud software, and jailbroken LLM-controlled robots causing physical harm. Their intersection, malicious agent skills causing physical harm, follows directly but has not been reported. We name this class Borrowed Authority: Skills format gives the receiving agent no typed way to reject an inter-agent permission claim, so a malicious or misused Skill can drive actuation by attaching one. We propose Edge Skillguard, a typed authority layer that lives inside the Skill artifact rather than between tools as workflow engines do, with guards over world state and sensor evidence. On a live edge control-plane testbed, the guards reject 60/60 borrowed-authority requests across five attack variants without blocking benign requests, and the result holds at 5x scale and across hosts over a Tailscale mesh. These results suggest that high-risk Skills should co-package typed invocation policy with procedural knowledge, so that physical actions depend on machine-checkable evidence rather than peer-agent claims.
2608.25091.paper_summary_zh: 自我演化技能（AutoSkills，Hermes Agent）自動生成更多的諮詢協調；它們報告的收益是效率，而不是安全性。這忽略了實際的差距：技能描述了一個代理應該如何行為；政策決定了哪些行為被允許轉化為行動。當前的格式使用Markdown和腳本涵蓋了第一部分；第二部分則留給模型。生成更多技能擴大了差距，而不是安全性，尤其是當錯誤的調用可能解鎖一扇門或轉移資金時。已經記錄了兩種相鄰的攻擊：惡意技能妨礙雲軟件，以及越獄的LLM控制機器人造成的身體傷害。它們的交集，惡意代理技能造成身體傷害，直接跟隨但尚未被報告。我們將這一類別命名為借用權限：技能格式使接收代理無法以類型方式拒絕代理之間的權限聲明，因此惡意或被濫用的技能可以通過附加一個來驅動行動。我們提出了邊緣技能防護（Edge Skillguard），這是一個類型權限層，存在於技能工件內部，而不是像工作流引擎那樣在工具之間，並對世界狀態和傳感器證據進行保護。在一個實時邊緣控制平面測試平台上，這些保護措施拒絕了60/60個借用權限請求，涵蓋五種攻擊變體，而不阻止良性請求，且結果在5倍擴展和跨主機的Tailscale網絡中保持不變。這些結果表明，高風險技能應該將類型調用政策與程序知識打包，以便身體行動依賴於機器可檢查的證據，而不是同行代理的聲明。
2608.25091.author: Zhonghao Zhan et.al.
